How it works

Everything your crew needs. Nothing it doesn't.

📋

Captain Mode

One captain subscribes and runs the scorecard. Everyone else joins free — and gets the full stats, history, and recaps automatically.

🏆

Crew Leaderboards

All-time wins, course records, Crew MVP, Ironman, Mr. Money Bags. Your crew's own Hall of Fame, built round by round.

✈️

Trip Recaps

Bandon. Pebble. The annual buddy trip. Full recap with podium, crew totals, bets, and memories — saved and shareable forever.

💰

Bets & Side Action

Beer bets, money pots, long drives. Track every wager and settle up with real numbers at the 19th hole.

🔥

Round Badges

Heated Up, Scrambler, Wild Thing, Disaster Artist — round-specific badges that tell the story no scorecard ever captures.

👻

Ghost Mode

Race your personal best, hole by hole. Watch the Ghost pace in real time and find out if today's finally the day.

The Origin Story

Built on a real trip.
Tested by a real crew.

Mulligan Crew started at a fire station — built during downtime by a firefighter who kept losing his crew's golf history after every trip. No investors. No co-founders. Just a guy who wanted a better scorecard.

The OC Crew — Seth, Shane, Tom, and Chase — have been the unwitting beta testers since day one. They complained. The app got better.

Your crew has a story.
Start keeping it.

Free to download. One captain, the whole crew gets the history.
